name: @aurum/desktop
description: Aurum Console — Windows desktop companion for Aurum
author: Aurum

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-renderer.mjs && node scripts/copy-brand-assets.mjs
scripts.test: tsx --test src/main/config-url.test.ts src/main/updater-state.test.ts src/main/launch-behavior.test.ts src/main/overlay-layout.test.ts src/main/overlay-ux.test.ts src/main/windows-audio.test.ts src/main/windows-capability.test.ts src/main/overlay-approval.test.ts src/main/overlay-approval-errors.test.ts src/overlay/approval-copy.test.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/stage-pack.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/stage-pack.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
